title_o: Fast But Fleeting: Adaptive Motor Learning Processes Associated with Aging and Cognitive Decline

replications.quote: our conceptual replication failed to reproduce the result of Trewartha et al. (Trewartha KM, Garcia A, Wolpert DM, Flanagan JR. J Neurosci 34: 13411–13421, 2014) and found that the spontaneous recovery was also similar across groups.
